THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF DHAR, SATYAM IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT 100 VAN NESS LLC EMERALD FUND, INC. CLARY, SHAWN DBA RESTORATION MANAGEMENT COMPANY PLAINTIFF ESTABLISHED THAT DEFENDANT 10 VAN NESS BREACHED ITS ORAL PROMISE TO ALLOW PLAINTIFFS' REPRESENTATIVE TO BE PRESENT WHEN ITEMS IN HIS APARTMENT WERE MOVED. HOWEVER, PLAINTIFF FAILED TO PROVE BY A PREPONDERANCE OF THE EVIDENCE THAT DEFENDANTS 100 VAN NESS AND EMERALD FUND CAUSED HIS CLAIMED DAMAGES. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
